title: ADAM-12 vaccine in cats with soft tissue sarcomas (Phase 0)
disposition_reason: Recruiting exploratory Phase 0 safety/feasibility trial of two first-in-cat ADAM-12 vaccine injections for confirmed recurrent, oversized or metastatic soft tissue sarcoma without feasible surgery or RT; standard treatment is not part of the protocol, and response is exploratory. Policy excludes from public therapeutic matching; retain as a research watchlist signal.
funding: Not published in official protocol; owner costs unknown.
deadline: No published cutoff in the current official individual protocol.
next_trigger: New primary evidence of a treatment cohort with credible therapeutic opportunity or defined standard-treatment backbone.
